title: Bouncing cosmologies from Born-Infeld-type gravity
summary: We construct a Born-Infeld-type $f(R,{\cal G})$ modification of gravity, where ${\cal G}$ is the Gauss-Bonnet term, by embedding Born-Infeld electrodynamics in a five-dimensional pure modified gravity. This method leads to the correspondence between curvature scalars and electromagnetic field strength scalars -- $R\leftrightarrow F_{μν}F^{μν}$ and ${\cal G}\leftrightarrow (ε_{μνρσ}F^{μν}F^{ρσ})^2$ -- allowing us to replicate the structure of Born-Infeld electrodynamics in the gravitational sector.
